name: gigglybits-theme-lab
description: A powerful, easy-to-use theme customizer for VS Code.

gigglybits.library.markdownDescription: Your saved themes, written by **Save theme** in the Theme Lab (**GigglyBits: Open Theme Lab**). Each is bound to one of the slots GigglyBits Theme 1 to 12. Use the Theme Lab or **GigglyBits: Choose Theme** rather than editing this by hand.

gigglybits.syntaxSets.markdownDescription: Your syntax sets, written by step 4 of the Theme Lab (**GigglyBits: Open Theme Lab**). A syntax set is a named set of code colors (keywords, functions, strings, tags and more) that a saved theme can use instead of its palette's, so code looks the same in every workspace. Use the Theme Lab rather than editing this by hand.

gigglybits.groups.markdownDescription: Your style groups, from an earlier version of the Theme Lab.
gigglybits.groups.markdownDeprecationMessage: Style groups are retired and nothing reads this setting. Syntax sets in step 4 of the Theme Lab replace the Editor text group; steps 3 to 5 cover tabs, lists and buttons per theme.

gigglybits.identity.hue.markdownDescription: This workspace's color as an OKLCH hue (0-359), from the retired per-folder color.
gigglybits.identity.hue.markdownDeprecationMessage: The per-folder color is retired into project frames: a project's color now lives in its saved theme's frame. Use **Use in this project** in the Theme Lab.

gigglybits.identity.pinnedColor.markdownDescription: A fixed hex color for this workspace, from the retired per-folder color.
gigglybits.identity.pinnedColor.markdownDeprecationMessage: The per-folder color is retired into project frames: a project's color now lives in its saved theme's frame. Use **Use in this project** in the Theme Lab.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run check-types:test && npm run lint && npm run themes:check && node esbuild.js --production && npm run smoke:bundle
scripts.verify: npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'out']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:pack: npm run clean && npm run pack
scripts.dev:quick: npm run build:pack && npm run install:local
scripts.full:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run dev:quick
